corpus_rule: SAME plus an independent mechanism remains KEEP_ATOMIC exactly once.
OVERMERGED or TRUNCATED historical records whose mechanisms are represented by canonical children/restores remain addressable but are inactive SUPERSEDED_NONLEAF records.
PARTIAL_PARENT is active only when a source-bound atomic residual remains after child subtraction; otherwise it is inactive.
Goal, outcome, rationale, heading and chapter-context text is CONTEXT_ONLY or DUPLICATE_RELATION and is not a second effect object.
Every versioned psr/front leaf occurs exactly once; historical text is immutable.
No source/effect denominator is frozen from scalar batch arithmetic; final counts derive only from explicit final roles after graph, collision, gap and terminal-layer gates pass.
